name: PlayMusic
definition: Play music, songs, albums, artists, or playlists on a media player.

name: AddToPlaylist
definition: Add a song, album, or artist to a specific playlist.

name: BookRestaurant
definition: Find or reserve a table at a restaurant, pub, or cafe.

name: GetWeather
definition: Check weather conditions or forecasts for a location.

name: GetMovieTimes
definition: Find movie schedules, showtimes, or cinemas playing specific movies.

name: RateItem
definition: Assign a rating or score to a book, album, or other creative work.

name: FindCreativeWork
definition: Search for a specific book, game, TV show, movie, soundtrack, or artwork.

name: PlayVideo
definition: Play TV shows, movies, trailers, or games on a media player.
